description: 阿拉伯杀：弃后引兵至h6，Rh7#将死
explanation_en: White sacrifices the queen to draw a black pawn onto h6, blocking a flight square so the rook can deliver Arabian mate with Rh7#.

intro.popup: 💡 阿拉伯杀：和上一题类似的弃后手法！要对这种棋形保持敏感。
intro.popup_en: 💡 Arabian mate: A queen sacrifice similar to the previous puzzle. Stay alert for this mating pattern.

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：和上一局类似，弃后引兵至h6，再Rh7#完成阿拉伯杀。多熟悉这种棋形和思路。
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: As in the previous game, sacrifice the queen to draw a pawn to h6, then finish the Arabian mate with Rh7#. Learn to recognize this pattern.

moves.popup: 白后弃后Qxh6+！将军，引诱黑兵来吃，封死王的逃格。
moves.popup_en: Qxh6+! White sacrifices the queen with check, tempting a black pawn to capture and blocking one of the king's escape squares.

moves.popup: 黑兵gxh6被迫吃后，走到h6后堵死了g7格。
moves.popup_en: gxh6. The pawn is drawn into capturing the queen and now occupies h6, blocking the g7 escape square.

moves.popup: 白车Rh7#，阿拉伯杀！黑兵堵住g7，马封逃格，王被将死。
moves.popup_en: Rh7# is Arabian mate! The black pawn blocks g7, while the knight covers the other escape squares.
